args.body:
Dear Customer,

Thank you for your patience. We have identified a discrepancy in your shipping site record. 

- The system initially recorded your shipping site as **Pune DC**, but the correct address on file is **Rotterdam DC-X924**. 
- We have processed your refund of **45** for the reshipping fee incurred due to this error. 

Your refund will be issued within **3–5 business days**. The reshipment will proceed to **Rotterdam DC-X924**, and you will receive a confirmation once it is completed. 

For reference, your ticket number is **C-4012**. Should you have any questions, reply to this email or contact our support team.

Best regards,
The Logistics Team
